title: MarsVanet reproducible cross-methodology benchmark, Phase 2

no_defense.reason: Ryu built-in learning switch; live forwarding remains unverified.

methodology1.behavior: Priority-100 drop for any IPv4 UDP from 10.0.0.3 on each connected switch; otherwise table-miss PacketIn L2 learning.

methodology2.behavior: Rate-based Stage 1 meter then Stage 2 drop for UDP toward 10.0.0.2 on configured AP2 ingress; default AP2 DPID 0x1000000000000002, in_port=1, out_port=2; ports require live confirmation.

methodology3.behavior: Consumes unfragmented, structurally valid UDP/5005, verifies source/vehicle identity, scores physical consistency and enforces per-vehicle reputation; not a generic volumetric flood detector.

volumetric_udp.family: legitimate UDP plus volumetric UDP flooding
volumetric_udp.phase_schedule: sta1 sends legitimate traffic in all three windows; sta3 attack traffic is off during baseline and recovery and on only during attack

safety_consistency.family: Methodology 3 safety-message consistency and reputation recovery with a concurrent data-plane probe

safety_telemetry.recovery: 200 checker-valid messages at 5/s; Methodology 3's actual checker/reputation classes validate the trajectory and expected score/action trace

attack.phase_schedule: starts at attack start and continues through transient attack, severe-throttle measurement, reputation recovery, normal-state confirmation, and post-recovery normal measurement

measurement_intervals.severe_throttle: Starts only after the expected baseline plus five-violation controller decision prefix and AP2 100-kbps meter operation are observed/acknowledged; configurable via --severe-measurement-seconds (0,60].
measurement_intervals.post_recovery_normal: Starts only after the complete expected 355-decision trace ends at reputation >=0.80/action NORMAL and AP2 REMOVE is acknowledged; configurable via --normal-measurement-seconds (0,60]. Unavailable if not confirmed before timeout.

metrics.probe_throughput: Attack payload bytes received by sta2 during the receiver-timestamp half-open interval, multiplied by 8 and divided by interval duration and 1e6.
metrics.probe_delivery_loss: For attack packets sent in the interval, join sender sequence numbers to receiver records across the entire trial to include boundary-late deliveries; PDR=delivered/sent and loss=1-PDR.

safety_consistency.interpretation: Only Methodology 3 is live-supported for safety_consistency. Sender records, controller decisions, OpenFlow barrier acknowledgements, and receiver traffic are independent evidence streams. A barrier confirms an operation was processed, not packet-level enforcement. Decisions are ordered against the expected trace because controller logs do not include telemetry sequence IDs. Recovery time is null when legitimate traffic was not impaired; reputation recovery and post-recovery data-plane measurements are reported separately.

reproducibility.seed_scope: same workload/repetition seed across defense configurations for paired offered load; distinct workload/repetition seeds

statistics.interval: two-sided Student t interval across independent repetitions; null interval if fewer than two observed values

metrics.legitimate_throughput_mbps: Successfully received legitimate application payload bits / attack-window seconds / 1e6.
metrics.packet_loss_ratio: 1 - received legitimate sequence numbers / sent legitimate sequence numbers.
metrics.packet_delivery_ratio: received legitimate sequence numbers / sent legitimate sequence numbers.
metrics.latency_ms: Median receiver arrival minus sender timestamp; record clock synchronization method and uncertainty.
metrics.attack_throughput_mbps: Successfully received attack payload bits / attack-window seconds / 1e6.
metrics.detection_delay_seconds: First controller detection evidence minus attack start; null when unobservable.
metrics.mitigation_delay_seconds: First confirmed enforcement minus attack start; null without controller/switch confirmation.
metrics.recovery_time_seconds: After attack end, time until legitimate throughput stays within 5 percent of pre-attack baseline for five consecutive seconds.
metrics.false_positive_count: Legitimate sources/vehicles incorrectly flagged or restricted during baseline and attack windows.

phase_2_status: single-trial volumetric UDP plus Methodology 3 safety-consistency live adapters; not live-validated in this environment
